items.title: Andy Anderson Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: The interviewee narrates stories about 'Big Cornish' and 'Dad' (likely a nickname for another musician, possibly 'Little Dad' or similar) fighting and playing together, but does not state a personal interaction or relationship with Big Cornish himself.

ctx.x: What about that fight between Big Cornish and Dad? You tell me about that once. Oh I'll tell you about Cornish and Dad.

And I'll tell you about Conius II. Conius II was another guy who had a fight. I didn't laugh at him, that you know, and he was playing gettoes them day. You see, gettoes started out in Dixieland, you know. And then the banjo took off, but getto was the first, you know. But he got the banjo because getto was in there to improvise then. The gipho was too soft, you know. That's when the banjo would come in. Well Cornish and Dad was a little bit of a fellow, you know. Oh, Cornish is about seven feet, you know. And…
